title: Evaluation after relabeling a Boolean table
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $p$ be a Boolean predicate on $\ell$-bit vectors, let $w$ assign a natural-number variable index to each position, and let $a$ be a Boolean assignment to the natural numbers. Relabeling the chosen CNF table for $p$ by $w$ evaluates to $p$ on the vector whose $i$-th bit is $a(w(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: A wiring map from positions to natural-number variable indices
A Boolean assignment to natural numbers
replaced: For every arity $\ell$, predicate $p$ on $\ell$-bit vectors, wiring map $w$ on variable indices, and assignment $a$, the relabeling of the chosen CNF table along $w$ evaluates to $p$ applied to the bits $a(w(0)),\dots,a(w(\ell-1))$; repeated wire indices are permitted and no injectivity is assumed.
